First, 49 weeks + 7 days = 49 × 7 + 7 = 343 + 7 = 350 days.  
Subtract 350 days from 1618-09-22.  
1618 is not a leap year (divisible by 2, not by 4).  
Going back 350 days:  
From 1618-09-22 back 22 days → 1618-08-31.  
Remaining 350 − 22 = 328 days earlier.  
From 1618-08-31 back 328 days:  
August has 31 days, so back 31 days → 1618-07-31.  
Remaining 328 − 31 = 297 days earlier.  
July has 31 days, back 31 → 1618-06-30 (297 − 31 = 266).  
June has 30 days, back 30 → 1618-05-31 (266 − 30 = 236).  
May has 31 days, back 31 → 1618-04-30 (236 − 31 = 205).  
April has 30 days, back 30 → 1618-03-31 (205 − 30 = 175).  
March has 31 days, back 31 → 1618-02-28 (175 − 31 = 144).  
February 1618 has 28 days, back 28 → 1618-01-31 (144 − 28 = 116).  
January has 31 days, back 31 → 1617-12-31 (116 − 31 = 85).  
December 1617 has 31 days, back 31 → 1617-11-30 (85 − 31 = 54).  
November has 30 days, back 30 → 1617-10-31 (54 − 30 = 24).  
October has 31 days, back 24 days → 1617-10-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1617-10-07
